observed.spec_change: refused: the task spec changed after the receipt; the unchanged pack is redelivered at the next refresh with the new revision and the write passes
observed.new_claim_generation: refused: the receipt predates the current claim of this task; passes after redelivery
observed.state_move_without_spec_change: receipt kept; the pack is deduplicated
observed.expiry: refused: the receipt expired; redelivered with the configured expiry
observed.outside_a_task: no consultation receipt is written and deduplication is unchanged
